# 🍎 Complete macOS Systems, Darwin BSD & Power User Track

Welcome to your full macOS learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-darwin-architecture` | **Darwin & XNU Kernel** | XNU (Mach microkernel + BSD layer + I/O Kit), Apple Silicon ARM64, `sw_vers` |
| `01-zsh-and-macos-shell` | **Zsh Environment** | Default Zsh, `.zshrc`, `/etc/paths.d`, PATH resolution, iTerm2/Warp |
| `02-package-management-homebrew` | **Homebrew Mastery** | Formulae vs Casks, `/opt/homebrew` vs `/usr/local`, `brew bundle` Brewfile |
| `03-apfs-filesystem-and-snapshots` | **APFS & Storage** | Apple File System (APFS), CoW clones, `tmutil` local snapshots, `diskutil` |
| `04-directory-domains-and-bundles` | **Domains & App Bundles** | User (`~/Library`), Local, System Domains (SIP read-only), `.app` anatomy |
| `05-launchd-daemons-and-agents` | **launchd & Plists** | PID 1 init system, LaunchDaemons vs LaunchAgents, `launchctl` commands |
| `06-sip-gatekeeper-and-security` | **macOS Security Architecture** | SIP (`csrutil`), Gatekeeper (`xattr -d com.apple.quarantine`), codesign, TCC |
| `07-macos-defaults-and-plists` | **Defaults & Plist Tweaks** | `defaults read/write`, `plutil` plist converter, hidden macOS system flags |
| `08-process-and-memory-pressure` | **Performance & Memory** | Activity Monitor CLI, `vm_stat`, `memory_pressure`, sampling processes |
| `09-networking-and-scutil` | **macOS Networking** | `networksetup`, `scutil`, PF (Packet Filter) firewall, Wi-Fi diagnostics |
| `10-keychain-and-credentials` | **Keychain Security** | macOS Keychain architecture, `security` CLI, certificate trust stores |
| `11-spotlight-and-metadata-indexing`| **Spotlight & Extended Attributes**| `mdfind` indexing, `mdls` metadata attributes, `xattr` management |
| `12-automation-applescript-jxa` | **Automation (JXA/Shortcuts)**| `osascript`, JavaScript for Automation (JXA), macOS Shortcuts CLI |
| `13-xcode-tools-and-compilers` | **Xcode CLI Toolchain** | `xcode-select`, clang / LLVM toolchains, SDK paths (`xcrun`) |
| `14-hardware-and-power-management` | **Hardware & Power** | `system_profiler`, battery stats (`pmset -g batt`), sleep modes |
| `15-virtualization-on-mac` | **Virtualization & Containers** | Apple Virtualization Framework (`vz`), Colima / OrbStack vs Docker Desktop |
| `16-backup-and-time-machine` | **Time Machine Automation** | `tmutil startbackup`, snapshot management, backup exclusions |
| `17-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 macOS SysAdmin / Jamf / DevOps interview scenarios & drills |

---

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 00 - Darwin & XNU Architecture 🛠️

### The 4 Pillars of XNU Kernel:
1. **Mach Microkernel**: IPC message passing, thread scheduling, virtual memory management.
2. **BSD Layer**: POSIX API compliance, networking (BSD sockets), process model, credentials.
3. **I/O Kit**: Object-oriented C++ device driver framework.
4. **libdispatch (GCD)**: Concurrency engine for Grand Central Dispatch.

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 01 - Zsh Shell & PATH Configuration

macOS uses `/usr/libexec/path_helper` to construct `$PATH` from `/etc/paths` and `/etc/paths.d/`.

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 02 - Homebrew Architecture

- **Apple Silicon (ARM64)**: Installs to `/opt/homebrew` (No sudo required).
- **Intel (x86_64)**: Installs to `/usr/local`.

```bash
# Export all installed packages to Brewfile
brew bundle dump --force

# Install all packages from Brewfile
brew bundle
```

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 03 - APFS Filesystem & Local Snapshots

- **Instant Copy-on-Write Clones**: Duplicating a 50GB file takes 0 milliseconds and 0 extra disk space!
- **Space Sharing**: Multiple APFS volumes share the same free pool in a container.

```bash
# Create a manual APFS local snapshot
tmutil localsnapshot

# List APFS volumes
diskutil apfs list
```

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 04 - Directory Domains & App Bundles

### Application Bundle Anatomy (`.app`):
```
MyApp.app/
└── Contents/
    ├── Info.plist        # Application metadata, permissions, version
    ├── MacOS/MyApp       # Executable binary
    ├── Resources/        # Assets, icons, localized strings
    └── _CodeSignature/   # Cryptographic code signing signature
```

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 05 - launchd Daemons & Agents

- **LaunchAgents (`~/Library/LaunchAgents/`)**: Run in the context of the logged-in graphical user.
- **LaunchDaemons (`/Library/LaunchDaemons/`)**: Run as `root` in the background with no GUI access.

```bash
# Load and start a LaunchAgent
launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) com.trak.service.plist
```

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 06 - macOS Security Architecture (SIP, Gatekeeper & TCC)

```bash
# Check System Integrity Protection status
csrutil status

# Remove Gatekeeper quarantine flag from downloaded tool
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /path/to/binary

# Verify code signature
codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 /Applications/MyApp.app
```

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 17 - High-Yield macOS & Apple Systems Interview Questions 🎯

### Top 5 Interview Questions:
1. **XNU Kernel Architecture**: Hybrid kernel combining Mach microkernel message-passing with BSD POSIX layer and I/O Kit.
2. **System Integrity Protection (SIP)**: Prevents even `root` from modifying `/System`, `/usr` (except `/usr/local`), `/bin`, `/sbin` to prevent malware persistence.
3. **LaunchDaemons vs LaunchAgents**: LaunchDaemons run globally as `root` without GUI access; LaunchAgents run within user login sessions.
4. **APFS Clones**: Copy-on-Write metadata pointers sharing existing disk blocks with zero immediate allocation cost.
5. **com.apple.quarantine**: Extended attribute attached by browsers to untrusted downloads, triggering Gatekeeper verification.
